issues.title: Use My Bookings at every entry point
issues.observed: Home says “Bookings”; Profile says “My Orders”. The list screen already says “My Bookings”, despite its exported filename.
issues.change: Use “My Bookings” on Home and Profile. Profile helper text: “Track your Daan Sevas, certificates and videos”. Both open the same destination. Check the longer Home label at mobile widths.
issues.check: Home and Profile reach the same My Bookings view without order terminology.
issues.source: Entry points and page header; Content updates to current screens

issues.title: Replace Chadhava with the three booking categories
issues.observed: The My Bookings screen has a “Chadhava Orders” control and three unbounded sections.
issues.change: Remove Chadhava. Prototype A with Nirantar Sevas, Upcoming and Completed tabs, and B with the same three ordered sections and View all previews. Use identical records and states. Prefer A for the first prototype; select the final layout after task testing.
issues.check: Both options cover the same data, including two beneficiaries and a payment issue; older certificates remain findable.
issues.source: My Bookings information architecture

issues.title: Separate the ongoing booking from each dated seva
issues.observed: The recurring card and date rail combine overall progress with tracking for an individual date. A dedicated parent detail is not supplied.
issues.change: Create separate Nirantar parent and occurrence detail views. Parent cards use “View Details”; dated cards use “Track Seva Details”. Keep the parent reference and occurrence reference distinct. One time sevas have no parent.
issues.check: Users can explain the difference between managing an ongoing seva and tracking one date; each dated record owns its bill and evidence.
issues.source: Booking model; Duplication rule; Nirantar Daan Seva detail

issues.title: Use Nirantar Daan Seva and a separate cadence
issues.observed: The list says “Recurring Sevas” and the date rail says “Recurring Sevas · Every Tuesday”.
issues.change: Use “Nirantar Sevas” for the category and “Nirantar Daan Seva” for the parent type. Show Weekly, Monthly, Every Amavasya or Every Ekadashi separately, followed by a readable schedule where known.
issues.check: All four cadences have appropriate labels and real dates when confirmed; no fixed weekly assumption leaks into lunar or monthly bookings.
issues.source: Terminology and naming; Cadence labels

issues.title: Identify the beneficiary on every booking and occurrence
issues.observed: List cards show “Rohit Sharma” without “For” or gotra; occurrence identity lacks beneficiary details. The profile gotra describes the account holder.
issues.change: Show “For {beneficiary name} · {gotra} gotra” on every parent and occurrence card and detail. Do not substitute the account profile identity. Keep a booking reference for identical names and gotras; let names wrap.
issues.check: Two identical sevas for different beneficiaries or gotras can be distinguished from the list. Bills and historical records keep the occurrence identity.
issues.source: Beneficiary name and gotra; Multiple booking identification

issues.title: Replace the eight box plan with continuing milestone progress
issues.observed: The parent says “1 of 8 sevas completed” with eight boxes; the date rail says “1 of 8 done”. This implies a finite booking.
issues.change: Use the configured recommended milestone, for example “4 of 7 recommended weeks completed”. Count performed occurrences only. At seven, recognise completion and show 7 of 14 when configured. Preserve the cumulative total and explain that AutoPay continues until cancelled through the UPI app.
issues.check: Reaching a target neither resets the count, stops AutoPay nor creates a milestone certificate. Nonweekly labels match their configured cadence.
issues.source: Core product decision; Recommended milestone behavior

issues.title: Make the next AutoPay charge visible
issues.observed: The parent shows AutoPay Active and ₹101 per seva, but no next debit date or distinction from the ₹51 introductory bill.
issues.change: Show current AutoPay state, actual next charge amount and date when known, alongside the next eligible seva and its registration state. Retain first charge and regular charge context in parent billing details.
issues.check: A user can distinguish the next charge date from the seva date and the introductory charge from the recurring amount.
issues.source: Nirantar Daan Seva card requirements; Pricing and AutoPay

issues.title: Show only eligible registered upcoming occurrences
issues.observed: The current static example has one scheduled card; the supplied designs do not define projected dates, duplicates or source labels.
issues.change: Upcoming contains only the next Registered or Scheduled occurrence per Nirantar parent plus all upcoming individual bookings. Use Nirantar or One time labels, beneficiary and gotra, full date including year, offering quantity and nearest first sorting. Unregistered future dates stay out of Upcoming.
issues.check: There is at most one upcoming occurrence per parent; payment discontinued dates are excluded; a parent and its next occurrence are intentionally allowed in separate categories.
issues.source: Relationship rules; Upcoming occurrence card requirements

issues.title: Use a tracking action for upcoming sevas
issues.observed: The upcoming scheduled card uses “Start Seva”.
issues.change: Replace it with “Track Seva Details” and route to that occurrence. This replacement is specific to a booked occurrence; acquisition CTAs on Home are a separate context.
issues.check: The action opens the selected beneficiary and date, with room for the full label at narrow widths.
issues.source: Terminology and naming; Primary action matrix

issues.title: Expose independent certificate and video states
issues.observed: The completed card still says “Start Seva”; the detail combines certificates and video into one future promise. No asset viewers are supplied.
issues.change: Keep every performed date in Completed, newest first, with actual amount and independent certificate and video readiness. Use View Seva Details while preparing, Watch Videos when available and View Certificate when ready. Add in app multi video playback and per asset Download and Share. Show the 48 hour expectation from performance; expose support if overdue.
issues.check: Certificate ready with videos preparing, videos ready with certificate preparing, multiple videos and one failed asset all work independently.
issues.source: Completed occurrence card requirements; Certificate and video experience

issues.title: Add the Nirantar parent detail and full history
issues.observed: The current Seva Status screen supplies a useful horizontal date rail, but no independent ongoing booking management page.
issues.change: Add identity, cadence, progress, next eligible seva, AutoPay, beneficiary management, email and WhatsApp support, and full date based history including Discontinued records. Keep the rail as an optional navigation component with state text and a View all history destination.
issues.check: An older certificate and a discontinued date remain reachable; projected dates never look registered or completed.
issues.source: Nirantar Daan Seva detail; Date navigation

issues.title: Use actual fulfilment events in the occurrence timeline
issues.observed: “Seva instructions” is shown as a completed green timeline stage. There is no explicit Performed event, and certificate and video delivery are combined.
issues.change: Use Booked, Scheduled and Performed as fulfilment stages. Move instructions into an expandable block. Add Discontinued for payment failure. Put certificate and video status in separate asset sections. Use the date scoped title “Daan Seva Details” with current status and beneficiary context.
issues.check: Reading instructions never changes fulfilment progress. Performed is explicit and evidence readiness does not change the performed state.
issues.source: Daan Seva occurrence detail; Timeline guidance

issues.title: Show rating only after performance
issues.observed: The supplied detail asks for a rating while the selected occurrence is still scheduled.
issues.change: Hide rating until the occurrence is Performed. Rating can be available while certificate or videos are preparing.
issues.check: Registered and Scheduled occurrences have no rating prompt; a performed occurrence can be rated before its media arrive.
issues.source: Rating visibility

issues.title: Design retry inactive and cancelled payment states
issues.observed: Only AutoPay Active is shown. No payment recovery, retry deadline or UPI cancellation state is supplied.
issues.change: Add Payment retrying, Inactive and Cancelled variants to parent cards and details. A failed payment discontinues the affected date; retries last up to 10 days. Successful retry registers the next eligible date without reviving the missed one. Inactive offers Restart Nirantar Seva; Cancelled offers Book This Seva Again. Explain UPI app cancellation. Include no pause or skip controls.
issues.check: Retry success and expiry preserve the missed date as Discontinued. Restart reviews the beneficiary and creates a new mandate when necessary.
issues.source: Payment lifecycle; Plan payment states; Cancellation and restart

issues.title: Add beneficiary editing and the locked support state
issues.observed: No parent beneficiary edit flow or post first seva locked state is supplied.
issues.change: Allow name and gotra review and editing before the first performed seva. Lock self service afterwards, with WhatsApp and Email Support. Preserve historical identities and define the precise lock timestamp with operations.
issues.check: Before first performance the update applies to first and future sevas; afterwards a change request goes to support and past bills or certificates are not silently rewritten.
issues.source: Beneficiary name and gotra; Editing rules

issues.title: Explain the actual amount in each occurrence bill
issues.observed: The detail bill is ₹51 while the recurring card says ₹101 per seva; the introductory relationship is not explained.
issues.change: Label the introductory occurrence bill “Amount paid ₹51 · Introductory price”. Later bills show the actual recurring amount paid. Place next expected AutoPay details in the parent; do not imply ₹51 repeats indefinitely.
issues.check: A first ₹51 bill and later ₹101, ₹121 or ₹151 bills match their actual records without contradiction.
issues.source: Pricing and AutoPay; Detail and completion updates

issues.title: Remove booking success claims before payment
issues.observed: Both exports say “We’ve booked your Dan Seva” and “Your name and gotra have been sent” while also saying “Pay to confirm”. Their green success treatment reinforces the conflict.
issues.change: Before payment use a review and payment state, for example “Review your Daan Seva”. Reserve booking success for confirmed payment and registration. Show sent or delivered only when the relevant operational event is confirmed. Add processing and pending verification states without a success promise.
issues.check: No unpaid or unverified state claims a confirmed booking. Successful payment without confirmed registration remains pending until verified.
issues.source: Payment lifecycle; Timeline guidance. Purchase screens are adjacent consistency fixes, outside the full checkout redesign scope.

issues.title: Disclose the first and regular amounts together
issues.observed: Home presents ₹51 against a struck ₹101 as an offer. The base payment export omits recurring pricing; the alternative adds only a small “₹101 autopay from next week · Cancel anytime” footer.
issues.change: Before confirmation show “First Daan Seva ₹51 · Then ₹101 every Friday until cancelled in your UPI app” for this example, using configured amounts and cadence. Keep the disclosure prominent beside the payment action. Reconcile the offer treatment on Home with the ongoing price. Do not infer an end after a milestone.
issues.check: Both amounts, cadence and the UPI cancellation route are readable before the user confirms. One time bookings never inherit recurring disclosure.
issues.source: Price disclosure; Confirmed product decisions. Checkout changes are limited to consistency with these product rules.

issues.title: Make beneficiary review explicit outside the illustration
issues.observed: The details form says “Your name”. Payment illustrations partially cover the name and gotra; the two variants use different gotras for their sample beneficiary.
issues.change: Use “Beneficiary name” or “Who is this seva for?” and display a plain name and gotra review block before confirmation. Carry the entered values forward unchanged. Keep them out of decorative artwork as the sole review surface.
issues.check: A booking for another family member is unambiguous; name and gotra are visible without interpreting the illustration.
issues.source: Beneficiary name and gotra; Initial booking. Form treatment is a design recommendation for the supplied adjacent screens.
issues.kind: Required identity with recommended form treatment

issues.title: Unify Daan Seva and the content glossary
issues.observed: HTML exports use “Dan Seva”; the PNGs use “Daan Seva”. Temple and ritual spellings also vary across the examples.
issues.change: Use Daan Seva and Nirantar Daan Seva consistently. Agree approved temple names and ritual transliterations with content and operations, then reuse them across UI, notifications and certificates. Do not assume differing offerings in separate samples are one booking.
issues.check: No “Dan Seva”, “Recurring Sevas”, Chadhava or customer facing order terminology remains in this booking journey.
issues.source: Terminology and naming; Content consistency

issues.title: Add empty loading synchronization and error variants
issues.observed: Supplied designs show populated happy paths; the form displays Verify and an empty OTP area together, with no supplied validation or expired code states.
issues.change: Add per category empty views, stable loading placeholders, data errors, preserved last known UPI state during sync, media loading errors and download or share feedback. For the adjacent form, design phone validation, OTP sent, invalid and expired OTP, resend and expiry states if that flow remains in scope.
issues.check: Loading does not falsely show Active or erase a ready asset. A failed video does not block a ready certificate. Form errors retain entered beneficiary information.
issues.source: Empty loading error and edge states; Loading and synchronization. OTP variants are an adjacent recommendation.
issues.kind: Required booking states with recommended form states

issues.title: Validate accessibility long content and small screens
issues.observed: The exports use fixed 393 by 852 containers with overflow hidden and bottom positioned actions. Some small helper text and long names need review; date states rely heavily on visual treatment.
issues.change: Add state text, selected semantics, readable progress and meaningful video labels. Let long beneficiary, temple and offering names wrap. Check contrast and comfortable touch areas. Validate scrolling, safe areas, keyboard and text enlargement; keep the payment action and price disclosure reachable.
issues.check: No clipping at 360 and 390 widths or enlarged text; focus order follows identity, status, instructions, media, bill, rating and support. Confirm contrast in the final design rather than assuming a failure.
issues.source: Accessibility and interaction requirements; Date rail behavior. Fixed layout observations describe the exports, not a tested production implementation.

issues.title: Choose one illustration style after the flow is correct
issues.observed: The base payment export uses flat vector artwork; the alternative combines rendered phone and temple images. Both spend substantial space on decorative delivery imagery.
issues.change: Choose one illustration family and use it consistently. Keep payment status, beneficiary review and recurring price higher in the hierarchy. Preserve the cream, deep brown and saffron identity and reusable rounded card treatment.
issues.check: The selected variant communicates the actual current state before decorative content, with all required information visible.
issues.source: Visual review of both payment exports; visual design system is outside the specification scope.
